author: Kåre Hampf
name: passport_guide
description: Adds a passport-photo cropping guide and aspect ratio based on Finnish police and ICAO 9303 biometric passport dimensions to the darkroom cropping tool.
description-extensive: This add-on gives you an overlay guide for cropping passport photos to the official size used across Europe. When you use the crop tool you can pick the passport guide to line up the head and framing correctly for biometric passport requirements. No extra software is required.
